```{r, fig.align='center',fig.height = 8, fig.width=10, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

################################Fig.1_Map of UZB####################################

library(cowplot)
library(colorRamps)
library(ggrepel)
library(sf)
library(ggspatial)

rm(list=ls())

# Read sites information
setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/map")
site <- read.csv("sample_metadata.csv",header = T)
toshkent <- data.frame(name="toshkent", latitude=41.2000, longitude=69.1800)

site.HMME<-st_as_sf(site,coords=c("longitude","latitude"),crs=4326)
site.HMME$plant<-factor(site.HMME$plant,levels = c("Bareland","Suaeda","Tamarix","Cotton","Maize"))

site.label <- site.HMME[1:3,]
site.label$plant <- c("Site 1","Site 2", "Site 3")

site.toshkent<-st_as_sf(toshkent,coords=c("longitude","latitude"),crs=4326)

# Read map information
uzb <- st_read("uzbekistan_regional.geojson")
water<- st_read("hotosm_uzb_waterways_polygons_geojson.geojson")

# Main of UZB map
mapUZ <-  ggplot() + 
          geom_sf(data = uzb, fill = "NA",color = "black", size = 0.3) + 
          geom_sf(data = water, fill = "#87CEEB", color = "#87CEEB", size = 0.3) +
          scale_size(range = c(1,5)) +
          annotation_scale(location = "bl", line_width = 1, text_cex = 1) +
          annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", which_north = "true",
                                 height = unit(1.5, "cm"), 
                                 width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                                 style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering) +
          #geom_sf(data=site.toshkent, color = "red", shape=15, size = 3) +
          geom_sf(data=site.HMME, aes(color = plant, shape = plant), size = 4) +
          geom_text_repel(data = site.label,aes(label=plant,geometry=geometry),stat = "sf_coordinates",color="black",size=3.5)+
          scale_color_manual(name = "Habitat", 
                             values = c("red","blue","black","darkgreen","deepskyblue"),
                             labels = c( "Bareland" = "Bareland", 
                                         "Suaeda" = "Suaeda", 
                                         "Tamarix" = "Tamarix", 
                                         "Cotton",  
                                         "Maize"),
                             guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = c( "Bareland" = "red", 
                                                                                 "Suaeda" = "blue", 
                                                                                 "Tamarix" = "purple", 
                                                                                 "Cotton" = "darkgreen",  
                                                                                 "Maize" = "deepskyblue")))) +
          scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,1,1,19,19)) +
          guides(shape = guide_none()) +
          coord_sf(crs = "+proj=laea +lat_0=42 +lon_0=64.5853") +
          theme_bw() +
          xlab("Longitude") +
          ylab("Latitude") +
          theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0),"mm"),
                #legend.position = "none",
                legend.title = element_text(size = 15,face = "bold",hjust=0),
                legend.text = element_text(size = 12,face = "bold"),
                axis.text = element_text(size = 12,colour = "black",face = "bold"),
                axis.title = element_text(size = 15,colour = "black",face = "bold")) 
          #theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10, unit = "pt"))
mapUZ 
# Small window of UZB map
mapUZ_detail <- ggplot() + 
                geom_sf(data = uzb, fill = "NA", color = "black",size = 0.5) +
                geom_sf(data = water, fill = "#87CEEB", color = "#87CEEB", size = 0.3) +
                scale_size(range = c(1,5)) +
                annotation_scale(location = "br", line_width = 1, text_cex = 1) +
                geom_sf(data = site.HMME, aes(color = plant), size = 4) +
                coord_sf(ylim = c(0,800), xlim = c(0,700),crs = "+proj=laea +lat_0=40.59 +lon_0=67.61") +
                scale_color_manual(name = "Habitat", 
                                   values = c("red","blue","purple","darkgreen","deepskyblue"),
                                   labels = c( "Bareland"="Bareland", 
                                               "Suaeda"="Suaeda",
                                               "Tamarix"="Tamarix",
                                               "Cotton", 
                                               "Maize")) + 
                scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(40.591,40.594,40.597)) +
                scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(67.610,67.614,67.618)) +
                guides(color = "none") +
                theme_bw() +
                theme(aspect.ratio = 0.8, 
                      plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0),"mm"), 
                      panel.grid = element_blank(),
                      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"))

# Combine the window with map
mapUZ_all <- ggdraw() +
             draw_plot(mapUZ) +
             draw_plot(mapUZ_detail, x = 0.48, y = 0.66, width = 0.33, height = 0.25)

# Link arrow bwtween window and map
p_all <-  mapUZ_all + 
          theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10, unit = "pt")) +
            geom_segment(aes(x = 0.595, y = 0.452, 
                             xend = 0.66, yend = 0.66), 
                         arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")), color = "darkgrey")

print(p_all)

# Different position of arrow
mapUZ_all1 <- ggdraw() +
              draw_plot(mapUZ) +
              draw_plot(mapUZ_detail, x = 0.45, y = 0.66, width = 0.33, height = 0.25)


p_all1 <- mapUZ_all1 + 
          theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10, unit = "pt")) +
          geom_segment(aes( x = 0.576, y = 0.445,
                            xend = 0.575, yend = 0.66), color = "darkgrey", linetype = 2) +
          geom_segment(aes( x = 0.588, y = 0.445,
                            xend = 0.705, yend = 0.66), color = "darkgrey", linetype = 2)

print(p_all1)


```
